option_relations.rationale: The option and leaf both describe an acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
The option is a subtype of the leaf, as it describes a specific type of ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
The option describes a different condition, cardiac tamponade, which is not directly related to the leaf.
The option describes a potential complication of the leaf condition, acute myocardial infarction.

decisions.rationale: Cardiac tamponade is a distinct condition unrelated to acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Acute inferoposterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is equivalent to acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Subacute left ventricular free wall rupture (LVFWR) is a potential complication of acute myocardial infarction.
